exact_contract.title: Exclude generated slot lanes and protect authored workspace members
exact_contract.goal: Keep generated boot cache files out of package content and avoid writing host-generated lanes into source package members.
steps: Reproduce a simple package with static requires under an XML consumer, nested static zones and a multi-fragment zone; compare the current next tree with the reported main-only fixpoint behavior.

Classify generated slot boot/STATIC.*, INDEX.md and .vibe-boot-* as derived artifacts outside authored package traversal and #use targets; retain every authored fragment exactly once, including static_boot_count greater than one.

In a disposable workspace whose members are source package slots, snapshot each member and run install/check; either prove no source mutation or fix output placement so generated host lanes and lock records stay in the consumer-owned derived location.
positive_cases: XML and Markdown consumers install the same authored static closure without parsing a generated multi-document lane as one spec.
Source member directories remain byte-identical after consumer install; package check does not read a generated lane as an authored single document.
negative_cases: A generated slot STATIC.xml/INDEX/.vibe-boot file enters simple package content or becomes a #use target.
Dropping a substituted multi-fragment unit loses authored content; install writes host cache files into vibepacks source members.
checks: SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: bind the affected vibe-workspace/vibe-cli/vibe-spec target and exact regression cases from source before compiling; use --lib or a named integration target.
RUN BOUND CHECKS: cargo test -p vibe-workspace --lib <reviewed case> -- --exact or the corresponding affected named target; require one nonzero selected case.
CONDITIONAL ORACLE: run codegen/specmap only if a changed schema, generator, source index or dependent contract actually requires it; do not use a broad gate from write perimeter alone.
acceptance: Keep generated boot cache files out of package content and avoid writing host-generated lanes into source package members.
Disposable positive and negative evidence is reviewed; any unavailable native Windows proof remains open rather than waived.
exact_contract.safe_stop: Keep the regression reproducible in a disposable fixture and report exact unsupported behavior until the affected path is fixed.
notes: Product-neutral regressions observed on a separate local main are hypotheses for this next checkout until disposable current-tree tests prove them. Do not copy fixture-specific package names or publish external package sets.
Maintain the mutable 1.1.0 cohort and the no-public-Git hold. Bind only affected tests; no mutation suite or routine whole-workspace gate.

root_review: Read complete pinned task and production payload/static-zone/publication diffs
Inspected actual joined CLI snapshots/fragment/lock-drift assertions and generated-payload controls
Read actual final logs with nonzero selections and no ignored tests
Reviewed canonical facts/revisions and links; verified26committed blob hashes; accepted exact original task boundary
limits: Native Windows/macOS not executed; original task explicitly retains unavailable native Windows proof as open
Native marker retained artifact route tested in Mixed, not retained multidocument XML
No public push/release; no authored manifest/schema epoch change
